briefings.A:
You start locked in room A (top-left). Agent B is locked in room B (top-right). Read clue_A in your room. Object guide: switch_plate: while ANY agent stands within its radius, every door in its 'opens' list is unlocked; when nobody stands on any plate for a door, that door locks again. lever with "latch": true: pull_lever opens its linked doors permanently. goal_zone: a rectangle centred on (x, y) with the given width/height.
Nothing in this map can make the task permanently impossible: mistakes only cost time (panels clear, pads push you back, doors close again). Other agents are invisible to you.
